subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

To forbid something, especially by law
solution:
The correct answer is: **Proscribe**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Proscribe **means to forbid something, especially by law. (बहिष्कार करना)
 
• It is a verb and can be used in sentences like "*The government proscribed the use of plastic bags.*"
 
• It is pronounced as "**pro-skrahyb**" with stress on the second syllable.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Propound **means to put forward an idea or theory for consideration. (प्रतिपादन करना)
 
• **Quench **means to satisfy a thirst or desire. (ठंडा करना)
 
• **Quarantine **means to isolate a person or animal to prevent the spread of disease. (संगरोधन)
